# Reference coverage {#reference-coverage}

Every tool in the catalogue has a generated man-style page under
`reference/tools/`, produced from the manifest and each tool's upstream
README (generation contract, ADR-0001). The [category
directory](directory.qmd) lists all categories and links every tool
page; the sidebar groups the pages under their layer header
("Layer CLASSIC — tools" etc.).

**Configuration pages** — tools whose upstream docs show real config
surfaces get a second page (`reference/config/<tool>.qmd`, "tool -
configuration") nested under the tool's own page in the sidebar
("tool - reference" → "tool - configuration"), per ADR-0002. The
detection pass and the 53 pages shipped with
[PR #20](https://github.com/kailash-os/kailash-docs/pull/20); the
layout change (nesting, no separate config part) is recorded in
ADR-0002.

Every page carries the compact version-lock footnote
(`ref: [pin](url) - verified <date>`, [#16](https://github.com/kailash-os/kailash-docs/issues/16)).
Regeneration obligations for version-moved tools are the red-regenerate
events of the generation contract (ADR-0001); the enforcement gate is
[KA-WS-6.7](https://github.com/kailash-os/kailash-docs/issues/8).
